ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels versus 25% low-intensity (black/dark-brown) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity regions forming the lobe centers; dark, irregular perimeter banding (approximately 5-15% lobe width) along the trailing and leading edges; a single distinct focal dark circular blob located in the mid-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees with a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular variations (peaks and valleys) along the continuous linear boundary; distinct deep V-shaped notches of 3-5 pixels depth observed on the distal trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves fitted to the trailing edges, tapering to acute, slightly upward-curving lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple sub-circular low-intensity pixel clusters (dark-on-white) localized primarily along the lower leading edge boundaries of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruption (~10% lobe height) extending from the lower-left leading edge into the high-intensity central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/trauma mark on the far-right trailing edge tip; prominent focal pigment lesion or dark scarring in the center of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel saturation (white clipping) on the central ventral surfaces due to exposure, limiting micro-texture extraction in approximately 40% of the fluke area.
